name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-mobile
description: native client shell for authenticated remote DeepSeek Harness sessions

scripts.check: pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-remote-wire exec tsc -b && pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-remote-relay-protocol exec tsc -b && tsc --noEmit
scripts.eas-build-post-install: pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-remote-wire exec tsc -b && pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-remote-relay-protocol exec tsc -b && pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-remote-wire run bundle && pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-remote-relay-protocol run bundle
scripts.preexport: pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-remote-wire exec tsc -b && pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-remote-relay-protocol exec tsc -b
